haikus.theme: National Great American Pot Pie Day
haikus.haiku:
Steam curls soft in air
Golden crust gleams, butter melts
Taste of home, heart sighs
Happy #NationalGreatAmericanPotPieDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bark echoes in halls
Canines parade wagging tails
Joyful paws step bright
Happy #DogsInPoliticsDay from @Clam

Golden trumpet gleams
Sax sings under velvet night
Joy drips like honey
#HappyBirthdayRayCharles from @ClamBakeSanta

Crimson leaves descend
Cool breeze hums through quiet woods
Earth sighs amber glow
Happy #AutumnEquinox from @ClamBakeSanta
